# Always-ready range copied by the boot stub

Ready before any section loads; boot guards and small stubs can live here.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x60030000` to `0x600d0800` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

The end comes from one immediate at 0x600211af. Everything else in block 0 loads later in ten sections.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Copy range and its end immediate read from the boot stub. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Boot guards placed in this range fixed intermittent boot failures (10 of 10 boots). Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
